standard-dialogue-after-the-giant-dwarf.npc: The new statue looks beautiful, don't you agree?
My finest piece of work, without a doubt.

standard-dialogue-after-the-giant-dwarf.player: Say, I was wondering, did you do the statues down in the mines as well?

standard-dialogue-after-the-giant-dwarf.npc: If only! But no, they've been there for many thousands of years, actually. Been there before dwarven recorded history.

standard-dialogue-after-the-giant-dwarf.player: No no, I'm sure they weren't there before!

standard-dialogue-after-the-giant-dwarf.npc: Of course they were, don't be silly!
